text:
The provided evidence is an abstract for a review article summarizing conventional and novel (microfluidic) isolation techniques, commercially available kits, and the global market demand for exosome assays. It does not test or support a specific experimental hypothesis involving a "thermosensitive copolymer matrix composed of poly(N-isopropylacrylamide-co-butyl methacrylate-co-N-hydroxysuccinimide methacrylate) (PNB)" combined with size-exclusion chromatography and a multi-aptamer capture system.

VERDICT: REJECT
